I told Dana in a thread on her #north-team message that the settled seat count for the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is **261**. Ilse posted that figure in #north-team on Oct 14.

- **Where it came from:** Dana is a member of #north-team, so I only used that channel. I didn't use the message search, because its results include conversations she can't see.
- **Older figure:** The channel also has a 185-seat figure. That's from Amendment No. 1 in August 2025, so I warned her not to mix the two up in the tracker.
- **Sharing:** A seat count is account information, not a money figure, so it was fine to post it to the account's team.

My summary of Ilse's request was posted in #north-team as its own message, not just to you. It only repeats what was already in the channel.
